blocks.text: One man has died and another was seriously injured when they were struck by an SUV that backed into a barber shop in Vanier on Tuesday afternoon, according to Ottawa police and paramedics. The driver faces an impaired driving charge.
Driver faces impaired driving charge after Tuesday afternoon crash
One man has died and another was seriously injured when they were struck by an SUV that backed into a barber shop in Vanier on Tuesday afternoon, according to Ottawa police and paramedics.
Emergency crews attended a scene at CuTzz Barber Salon on McArthur Avenue east of the Vanier Parkway around 5:40 p.m., according to paramedics on Tuesday.
Ottawa police said Wednesday morning a 29-year-old man died of his injuries on the way to a hospital. They did not identify him.
A 32-year-old man who was also struck was taken to hospital in serious, stable condition.
The 57-year-old woman driving faces an impaired driving charge, police said. They allege she was impaired by drugs.
McArthur was closed after the crash but has since reopened.
With files from Dan Taekema and Joseph Tunney
